description: A 105-combination breakout sweep scored on the test set, plus a grid search whose best_score_ is reported as out-of-sample.

expected.note: A 36-point parameter grid with no multiple-testing correction.
best_score_ is the maximum over the search, printed as if it measured the model.
Every combination is scored against `test` and the maximum is returned.
The test set is passed as eval_set, so it chooses the stopping iteration.
